content.text: The bulk shipment has arrived!
Finally here, hehe, the onlookers are online.
@Alex Looking forward to seeing your collection this time. The previous teaser was too captivating.
The unboxing ceremony begins, with the foam protective layer being very secure.
@Alex This packaging is indeed very professional, looking forward to the surprise inside.
Check out this imposing 1/4 scale statue!
@Alex This pose is very similar to the one in the movie poster, and the details are quite well-reproduced!
@Yuzu Indeed, the statue has a powerful presence, closely resembling the character's demeanor in the movie.
@Alex The paint on this belt has overflowed; it doesn't seem very good.
@Pineapple, this little flaw is nothing. Just take a look at my display cabinet.
@Alex Actually, the painting isn't a big issue; the overall effect still looks quite good.
@Alex Is there a difference between the official images and the actual product?
The limited edition number is 007/500. It is indeed a bit smaller, but that's where the value of a limited edition lies.
@Alex I heard this item is being sold at a high price on Xianyu. You made a profit!
I bought this Blu-ray steelbook, and the interior design is also fantastic.
@Alex My poster signed by the director is truly priceless, haha.
@老孟 Your collection is truly classy, I'm envious.
Everyone, take a look at this powerful full-body photo!
@Alex This is indeed cool, but have you noticed the belt part? I think the paint job has a bit of overflow.
@Pineapple, you have a sharp eye, but the overall effect is still fantastic.
This pose reminds me of a classic scene from a movie poster.
@Yuzu Yes, the pose is highly accurate, especially in the details.
@Yuzu That poster is indeed a classic; I still remember the craze when it was first released.
Take another look at this close-up of the head sculpture—the texture is incredibly detailed!
@Alex This detail is indeed well-handled, I admit.
@Alex The texture of this skin looks so realistic, no wonder you like it so much.
Speaking of limited editions, the 007 on your nameplate is such a lucky number!
@老孟 Yeah, this serial number makes it more collectible.
@Alex The current market price is quite high, isn't it? You've really hit the jackpot.
Such rare serial numbers are highly sought after in the collecting world.
It seems this statue is not just a display piece, but also an investment.
Yes, although there are some flaws, the overall collection value is still quite high.
Everyone, take a look at the details of this base. What do you think?
@Alex The base has a high degree of restoration, especially the ruin effect, which feels like a scene from a movie.
@老孟 Yeah, the weather effects are really realistic.
@Pomelo The details are indeed good, but the flaws we discussed earlier cannot be overlooked.
Take another look at the painting on this belt. Does it seem a bit color-bleeding?
@Alex I've said it before, the color boundary of the belt isn't very clear, which is a minor flaw.
@Pineapple Such minor issues are common in limited editions, but the limited edition number and overall value are what truly matter.
@Pomelo You're right, limited edition numbering is indeed one of the factors that determine collectible value.
Look at my full wall of display cabinets; this minor flaw doesn't really affect the overall effect, does it?
@Alex Your display cabinet is truly spectacular, and all these collectibles look amazing.
@Yuzu Indeed, Alex's collection is displayed very effectively.
@Alex With so many collectibles, how do you usually maintain them? I have a statue that has actually faded a bit after being stored for a long time.

@老孟 There are three main points to note: first, avoid light, as UV lights are the number one killer. I use UV-protective glass for my display cabinets; second, control humidity. If the humidity exceeds 60%, the paint surface is prone to bubbling. I place desiccants in my cabinets; third, dust regularly. Use a soft brush to gently sweep, and never wipe with a damp cloth.
There's so much to it; I had no idea before.
Indeed, if figurines are properly maintained, their condition can remain as good as new even after ten years, and their resale value can vary significantly.
@老孟 Although the display effect is good, I still think the flaws might affect the potential market value.
@Pineapple I think the limited edition number 007 and the overall display effect are sufficient to offset these minor flaws.
@Alex Moreover, the limited edition number is quite competitive in the market and is likely to appreciate further.
@Yuzu That's right, as long as there is market demand, the value of limited editions won't easily decline.
Everyone, take a look at this official image and tell me if it looks like it's been downsized.
@Alex The lighting effects in the official images seem better, and the actual paint job still looks a bit smudged.
@Pineapple I think the lighting has a significant impact, and perhaps the actual object doesn't feel as refined.
The lighting effects do have an impact, but overall, I think it's quite good.
Let me show you the limited edition number, 007/500. It really has great collectible value!
@Alex 007 is indeed a great number, it's quite a highlight.
@Alex This number is really cool; its rarity has increased quite a bit.
007/500, this number is truly enviable.
I took a look at the price on the game's official website—6,000 yuan. Alex, you really scored a deal!
@Pineapple It seems my collection this time is quite valuable.
Wow, I didn't expect the market price to have risen this high. Alex really has a good eye this time.
The collectibles market is indeed as hot as ever, and Alex's eye for this one was spot on.
@老孟 Your signed posters are no less impressive; these collections are truly enviable.
Haha, it seems everyone's collections are quite valuable.
Thank you for the discussion. Looking forward to sharing new collections with everyone next time.
Just got the Blu-ray steelbook, how does it look?
@Alex This cover art is quite unique; the color palette really sets a mood.
This design has a bit of a retro feel to it; I like this style.
@Alex, is this tin box a limited edition?
Yes, look at the disc design inside. The details are quite nice, aren't they?
@Alex The design of the inner sleeve of the disc looks very collectible.
The pattern is highly accurate in its reproduction, making it a fine collectible.
This design is truly thoughtful, better than many standard versions.
But when it comes to collecting, check out this poster signed by the director! I got this piece when I was twenty-two.
@Alex Wow, this signed poster is truly a game-changer, so cool!
Such a poster hanging on the wall is definitely the highlight of any collection!
This is no ordinary collection; getting a signature is truly not easy.
Yes, I'm really excited to have gotten this signature too.
It seems we are all going further and further down the path of collecting.
This must be the joy that comes from a hobby—it's more fun when shared with everyone.

meta.full_summary:
对话开始。
(第1段摘要): 大家对Alex的新收藏展开热烈讨论，虽然菠萝指出了涂装瑕疵，但整体展示效果仍被认可。Alex展示了限量编号和其收藏价值，老孟最后以签名海报展示进行降维打击，结束对话。
(第2段摘要): Alex展示了1/4雕像的全身照，引发大家对细节的讨论，特别是腰带涂装的瑕疵。柚子和老孟对比了雕像与电影海报的姿势，Alex展示了头雕的细腻纹理。大家对限量编号007的稀有性和价值进行了讨论。
(第3段摘要): 大家对Alex的雕像底座和腰带涂装进行了讨论，虽然有瑕疵，但整体展示效果得到认可。展示柜中的收藏品让大家赞叹不已。
(第4段摘要): Alex展示了官图和限量编号，大家对涂装和编号进行了讨论。菠萝展示了闲鱼市场的高价截图，大家对收藏的价值表示认可。
(第5段摘要): Alex展示了新买的蓝光铁盒和内部设计，大家对其设计的艺术性和收藏价值展开讨论。随后，Alex展示了导演签名的海报，大家对此表示了极大的赞赏。
resolved_events: Alex展示了1/4雕像的全貌，限量编号和瑕疵问题得到了讨论
Alex展示了官图和限量编号，闲鱼市场价格讨论
收藏细节的涂装瑕疵争议
